findings.highlight: All I know is that I don't know much.
findings.evidenceJa: はっきりしているのはこの手に余る、という事だけだ。
findings.governingReading: The only certain fact is that this situation exceeds what he can handle.
findings.explanation: Beyond his ability becomes little knowledge.

findings.highlight: I suppress my nausea as I make my way through the mansion.
findings.evidenceJa: 目眩を堪えながら屋敷をまわる。
findings.governingReading: He bears dizziness while going around the house.

findings.highlight: "What's with these negative thoughts, you idiot. You're whining."
findings.evidenceJa: 「……なに腐ってるんだ、バカ。今のは、とんでもなく失礼な弱音だった」
findings.governingReading: He condemns the autonomous tank image as grievously rude to the girl, not merely defeatist.
findings.explanation: A terribly disrespectful weak thought becomes generic whining.

findings.highlight: She must be in the dojo or the shed if she isn't in the house itself.
findings.evidenceJa: ここまで探していないとなると、後は—
findings.governingReading: Having searched rooms, he leaves the next possibility unfinished, then considers yard/shed and suddenly remembers the dojo.
findings.explanation: The not-yet-identified next search site becomes a dojo-or-shed certainty.

findings.highlight: She walks toward me, before I can think of what to say.
findings.evidenceJa: 何を言うべきか考えつかないまま、彼女へと歩み寄る。
findings.governingReading: He cannot think what to say while walking toward her.
findings.explanation: Shirou approaching her becomes her approaching him.

findings.highlight: Saber stiffens, as if surprised to see me upset at her.
findings.evidenceJa: 怒鳴られて驚いたのか、セイバーは意表を突かれたように固まったあとまじまじと、なんともいえない威厳でこっちを見つめてくる。
findings.governingReading: After stiffening in surprise she scrutinizes him with indescribable dignity.

findings.highlight: If it's true, I'll need to respect Saber's needs and actions as best I can.
findings.evidenceJa: なら俺は、自分に出来る範囲でセイバーに負担をかけないようにするしかない。
findings.governingReading: He must do what he can to avoid imposing more burden on her.
findings.explanation: Avoiding burdens on Saber becomes respecting her needs and actions.

findings.highlight: "Ah... No, I also failed to grasp your intentions and jumped to conclusions. You are not at fault, so may you please raise your head...?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「ぁ……いえ、私もマスターの意図が掴めずに早合点してしまいました。シロウは悪くないのですから、頭をあげてくれませんか……？」
findings.governingReading: She asks him to lift his head because the misunderstanding is her fault too.
findings.explanation: A courteous request uses may you please.

findings.highlight: In addition to doing everything we can, I've decided to team up with Tohsaka for the time being. Remember her? The girl who was with us last night, Archer's Master."
findings.evidenceJa: 出来る範囲でなんとかするって言っただろ。その一環として、しばらく遠坂と協力する事になったんだ。ほら、昨日一緒にいた、アーチャーのマスター」
findings.governingReading: Working with Rin is one part of doing what they can within their means.
findings.explanation: Cooperation as part of the bounded effort becomes in addition to it.
